hypothesis: The last trading session of each month plus the first three trading sessions of the next month have a positive, transferable equity return premium.

rule.entry: open of the last trading session of each calendar month
rule.exit: open of the fourth trading session of the following calendar month
rule.lookahead: calendar positions only; no price-derived parameter

notes: This is a single published-style calendar rule, not a parameter search.
Performance is evaluated before costs only to establish whether a statistical gross edge exists.
2025 is sealed and must not be read.
